description:
Generate a shareable snapshot of an existing report and return its public URL. WRITE action — requires the write scope. Note: this snapshots the report's CURRENT widget state (deduped by content hash) — it does not take a date range and does not run a template; edit the report's widgets/filters first if you need a different period. Returns report_id, snapshot_id and url. Errors: reporting_not_available if the plan does not include SEO Reporting, not_found for an unknown reportId. Get the reportId from list_reports. Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties.

Cost: 1 credit per call.

Examples:
```json
// generate a shareable snapshot URL for the report.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","reportId":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"}
```
name: generate_report
title: Generate report snapshot
